tools.name: find_bottleneck
tools.description: Single Run bottleneck analysis for the selected chapter — which node has the worst availability, per-interrupt downtime split, throughput, OEE. All eight chapters return verified saved results. ANTI-FABRICATION: numbers in the response are canonical reference values from real ReliaSim engine runs. Q

tools.name: get_chapter_facts
tools.description: Structural facts of the selected chapter — topology, rate limits, interrupt distributions, expected efficiency. Use when the user asks about the line's configuration. ANTI-FABRICATION: rates and distributions are verified values from the model file. Quote VERBATIM; do not estimate or substitute trai

tools.name: get_chapter_narrative
tools.description: Long-form narrative for the selected chapter — what the chapter adds to the complexity ladder and the key teaching point. Use when the user asks 'walk me through this' or wants the conceptual primer. Pure prose, no numerical claims; safe to summarize.

tools.name: run_gain_loss
tools.description: Gain/Loss experiment — disable each interrupt one at a time, measure production recovered. Reveals the ACTUAL impact of each failure mode (Gain ≠ Loss: removing one lets others fire more often). Available on `bs1-leds`, `bs3-leds`, `bs4-ct`, `bs4-leds`. Use when the user asks 'what if we fixed X?' /

tools.name: run_buffer_tradeoff
tools.description: Buffer Tradeoff experiment — sweep a buffer's capacity from 50 → 10,000 units, measure throughput gain. Shows the diminishing-returns elbow for buffer sizing.
